text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, man, I'm craving ice cream. Soft 
serve! Hey, let's go get some!

After our outing, at Jungle Pocket's 
request, we head into town in search of 
soft-serve ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Pokke. Out shopping?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Came to get some soft-serve. Jordan, tell 
me a good place.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'K, one soft serve.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Sounds great, right Trainer?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"These strawberries are so good! Man, when 
it comes to stuff like this, Jordan never 
misses!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, give me a bite of your chocolate. 
I'll give you a bite of my strawberry in 
return.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way. Pokke, your 'one bite' is 
definitely not just one bite.

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member
text_block_list.text: Ah, Pokke-san! 'Sup!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo, you guys. Look as free as ever. 
Wandering around aimlessly as usual, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Pokke's pal? Was it "L/Roars"?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That's right! She's our current Boss, got 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Leader! Whooooaaa, amazing.

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
No, compared to Pokke-san, I still have a 
long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, after eating ice cream, I want 
something salty. Wanna hit up a family 
restaurant?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Then can we tag along too?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Come on, Trainer. Jordan, you too.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—An' then, Pocket-san totally lost it. 
"Leavin' the cherry on a cream soda is 
unforgivable! It's the main star, damn 
it!" she went.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Calling it the star of the show? 
Though I get it, some of my gal pals are 
like that too. Getting mad when the waiter 
clears their glass with just the cherry 
left.

I was worried since she seemed a bit 
intimidated at first, but Tosen Jordan 
appears to be fitting right in. She was 
having a lively chat about family 
restaurant gossip, but—

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Leader? Is something wr— Wh-?! That 
message!

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san, sorry. Looks like our guys are 
getting into a scuffle with another team. 
I'm heading over there right now.

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Leader, are those guys at it again?! 
Dammit, they never learn...!

With a single word from their leader, the 
members of L/Roars erupted into an uproar. 
The atmosphere alone made it clear that 
this was no ordinary situation...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...What happened?

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
"...One of the teams L/Roars absorbed in 
the past broke away recently. We've been 
having some skirmishes with those guys..."

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it was just a little skirmish. 
—Hey, let's move!

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member
text_block_list.text: Yes!! Excuse me for a second, Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh.

Jungle Pocket casually saw off her 
teammates.
choice_data_list: Is it okay not to chase them?
To hear there's trouble... I'm worried...

To hear there's trouble... I'm worried, 
you know...

text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket casually saw off her 
teammates.
choice_data_list: Is it okay not to chase them?
To hear there's trouble... I'm worried...

To hear there's trouble... I'm worried, 
you know...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! You sure you don't wanna chase 
after him?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the team in a pinch? Ain't everybody 
countin' on Pokke?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Those guys aren't looking for me to fix 
things for them.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The current Head is the President. She 
knows it, too. She didn't consult me once, 
did she?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“—If you rely on others, you ain't fit to 
be the leader.”
choice_data_list: So you really trust the Boss, huh?
So you really trust the Boss, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm having them shoulder 
L/Roars.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ………………Damn it. And she's just Pokke...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that supposed to mean, 'for 
me'?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care! Don't look at me, stupid 
Pokke!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Not at all?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Even if we're on different paths 
now, friends are friends. I'd hate it if 
something bad happened!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You guys... are so nice.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you seriously don't need to worry. 
You saw, right? The Head and the whole 
team went out together.”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
A bond like that won't be broken so 
easily.
choice_data_list:
So you really trust in your team bonds, 
huh?

You really trust in your team bonds, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Plus, knowing it's a crucial time in 
the Twinkle Series right now, it looks 
like they're trying to avoid dragging me 
into it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I stick my nose into it, wouldn't that 
just make 'em mad instead?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Then maybe it's fine? But still, 
doesn't it kind of bother you?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, having Jordan worry about them 
makes them a lucky bunch!
